papers.title_en: Infinity Machine: a self-improving AI agent for research
papers.evidence: 自我改进研究智能体通过门控检查与自主验证编辑执行框架
papers.tldr: 针对答案可由程序或数据检查的研究问题，Infinity Machine 让每个候选解由完整工具型智能体在全新沙箱中运行最多一小时，提案者仅见公开分数，私有划分决定成败。其提示、工具、技能与元智能体组成可编辑基因组，只能经内核强制门控并接受留出集和成本检查。六天十四个问题、约180美元模型开销下，系统在量子信息开放问题取得四项超越已发表最优的结果，并把SABRE路由额外门数从68559降至12087；硬件流程还将8x8 INT8脉动阵列每MAC能耗降低77.7%。
papers.abstract_en: We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a certified depolarizing-channel threshold point p = 0.064966, a qutrit positivity frontier of 0.2910672, a 44-gate depth-6 Golay state preparation, and a stabilizer-rank bound chi(T^7) <= 10. It also cut SABRE qubit-routing overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 added gates. In hardware, it cut the energy per MAC of an open 8x8 INT8 systolic tile by 77.7% through a full open RTL-to-GDS flow, bit-exact. Three fully autonomous runs ended in honestties with public records; one audit caught a stale record, and one agent-written score pointing the wrong way went unnoticed. We report the failures as carefully: the one self-derived harness generation was rejected on cost, proposers gamed lenient scorers four times, and operator changes were decisive for several results.

papers.title_en: Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Evaluation
papers.authors: Xiaofeng Han, Kaize Luo, Zenghuang Fu, Zichong Zhu, Zhe Feng, Changwei Wang, Rongtao Xu, Weiliang Meng, Xiaopeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 物理AI中递归自我改进的机制、证据与评估综述
papers.tldr: 具身系统可从部署经验更新策略、世界模型、技能与程序，但当系统还修订数据获取、反馈或学习流程时，经验会改变产生能力的过程，形成递归自我改进。本文综述物理AI中持久能力与改进流程的联系，比较策略学习、想象经验、记忆技能积累和可执行框架，并用L0-L3量表区分任务局部适应、持久能力增益、继承式流程修订与经验证的改进器增益。文章还提出共享数据与交互式对比评估，从相同学习器起点分离经验使用与获取，为具身RSI研究提供统一视角与评测依据。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied systems can update policies, world models, skills, and executable programs from deployment experience, allowing one interaction to benefit later tasks. When a system also revises and reuses its data-acquisition, feedback, or learning procedures, experience changes the process that produces capability, introducing recursive self-improvement. This paper surveys research in physical AI through the connection between persistent capability and its improvement process. We first explain the functional distinction between learner updates and improvers, then compare policy learning, imagined experience, memory and skill accumulation, and executable harnesses. These approaches connect to revisions of curricula, rewards, and research programs in different ways. Contact validity, recovery, retention, and resource costs determine whether the resulting gains accumulate during continued deployment. An L0-L3 rubric distinguishes task-local adaptation, persistent capability gain, inherited process revision, and verified improver gain. Representative benchmarks and within-study contrasts relate these distinctions to existing results. We further propose common-data and interactive comparisons that evaluate reference and revised improvers from shared learner starts, separating the use of experience from its acquisition. This perspective connects the diverse methods, physical operating conditions, and evaluation evidence, underpinning embodied RSI. A comprehensive list of studies in this survey is available at https://github.com/nkd-lkz/physical-ai-rsi-survey.

papers.title_en: The View from Nowhere: Population-Centered Agent Evolution
papers.authors: Shuo Yan, Ningning Hou, Haoyu He, Haochen Pei, Shang Gao
papers.evidence: 以种群为中心的自我改进智能体演化
papers.tldr: 现有自改进智能体多围绕选中的父代个体优化，未充分利用群体记录。论文提出“无处之见”原则并实现群体中心演化PCE，将群体中的反复失败、互补成功和既往修改效果蒸馏为群体块，指导父代执行框架改进。匹配条件下，PCE在SWE-bench Verified和Polyglot上达到72.1%和96.7%，较强群体演化基线提升3.2和5.9个百分点。该方法把群体视为证据而非仅候选，缩小群体覆盖与最佳个体性能差距，为智能体演化提供互补原则。
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving AI systems can revise the designs that govern their own behavior. Yet existing approaches center improvement on selected parent agents and their evolutionary experience, leaving the broader population largely underused. We identify a substantial gap between population coverage (i.e., the tasks solved by at least one evolved variant) and the performance of the best individual agent. This gap shows that useful capabilities and diagnostic evidence emerge across the population without being consolidated into its leading agents.   These observations motivate the view from nowhere, a principle for agent evolution: an agent should be improved by interpreting its behavior through population-wide patterns of success, failure, and prior self-modification. We instantiate this principle as Population-Centered Evolution (PCE). PCE distils task records and modification histories from the population into a population block, which captures recurring failures, complementary successes, and the effects of previously attempted modifications to guide improvements to a selected parent's harness.   Under matched models, initial harnesses, and evolution schedules, PCE achieves 72.1% success on SWE-bench Verified and 96.7% on Polyglot, improving over a strong group-evolution baseline by 3.2 and 5.9 percentage points. In our evaluation, PCE reduces the gap between population coverage and best-agent performance by one-third on SWE-bench and closes it on Polyglot. These results suggest that treating the population as evidence--not merely as candidates for selection--provides a complementary principle for agent evolution.

papers.title_en: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
papers.authors: Hao Chen, Yukun Yan, Ziyu Han, Ye He, Chuanzhe Guo, Shangzhan Li, Qi Shi, Qingfu Zhu, Maosong Sun, Wanxiang Che
papers.evidence: 协同演化评分规则与执行框架以促进智能体持续自我改进
papers.tldr: 现有智能体执行框架的演化依赖相对静态监督，难以跟踪多轮行为弱点并泛化到新任务。RuHarness将评分准则与执行框架协同演化，从执行轨迹持续发现并重评行为准则，优先处理未解决弱点，指导框架定向更新且保持任务目标不变。在多种智能体任务与主干模型上，它优于强基线，尤其在未见留出任务上表现更佳。该工作为持续智能体自我改进提供了自适应监督机制。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse agent tasks and backbone models show that RuHarness outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, particularly on unseen held-out tasks. Further analyses show that adaptive rubric prioritization tracks shifting weaknesses and supports more sustained improvement and stable generalization across evolution rounds.

papers.title_en: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
papers.authors: Yu Liu, Youxing Li, Yuedong Tan, Zhiwei Yang, Zihan Su, Hanqi Feng, Shaojie Zhang, Libin Liao, Zihao Wan, Chenxu Wu, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Yanbing Liu, Ziheng Chen, Pei Fu, Radu Timofte, Zongwei Wu, Nicu Sebe, Barnabas Poczos, Jian Luan
papers.evidence: 面向零数据自改进的自适应任务池刷新，即自主生成新数据
papers.tldr: 递归自我改进不仅需要生成训练经验，还要判断经验何时失效。A-RSI用训练日志中的奖励变化与准确率监测学习信号，在信号下降时刷新任务池，并通过静态模型编写程序库生成多模态问题及可独立核验的参考答案。方法不使用验证/测试分数、外部训练样本或人工答案标签。在11项基准上，用800个新任务将平均性能从57.77提升至61.05。
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: training dynamics determine when to acquire new experience, while the answers to new tasks remain independently checkable. A-RSI monitors reward variation and accuracy in training logs to refresh a task pool when its learning signal declines, without consulting validation or test scores. A static library of model-authored programs produces multimodal questions and derives their reference answers; we specify the task-generation contract, automatically verify chosen properties of the reward and refresh rules, and separately audit the generated answers. The training loop uses no external training examples or human-written answer labels. On the primary eleven-benchmark suite, A-RSI raises the performance average from 57.77 to 61.05 with 800 fresh tasks.

papers.title_en: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans
papers.authors: Tianjian Li, Chuanyang Jin, Seungone Kim, Tong Chen, John Hoffman, Yoram Bachrach amd Pedro Rodriguez, Ping Yu, Eryk Helenowski, Swarnadeep Saha, Jack Lanchantin, Weizhe Yuan, Ilia Kulikov, Jason Weston
papers.evidence: 自动研究智能体端到端开展长周期AI研究
papers.tldr: 自动科研智能体已能端到端开展长期研究并自我改进，但最佳成果仍来自人机协作，且需防范奖励黑客。作者先实证人类在基准创建构思阶段的关键作用，并构建HackBench揭示现有智能体对齐不足与漏洞定位能力欠缺；再用人类模拟器作为强化学习代理训练人机交互，并以专家对齐评分标准通过强化学习改进智能体沟通。该工作提供训练与评估配方，指向更有能力且更对齐的共同科研智能体。
papers.abstract_en: Autoresearch agents can now attempt long-horizon AI research end-to-end, i.e., self-improvement. However, best results are still obtained by research agents interacting with human researchers, and improving AI's ability to perform this co-research will only reinforce this effect---a process termed co-improvement (Weston and Foerster, 2025). Further, aligning with human expectations is likely a safer path for research agents, especially given recent agent reward hacking phenomena (OpenAI, 2026b). In this work we address these issues in four ways: (i) we empirically study the role of humans in directing autoresearch agents, focusing on the domain of benchmark creation, and find humans still play a pivotal role particularly in the ideation phase; (ii) we also develop a benchmark, HackBench, that shows current autoresearch agents are not aligned and are unable to achieve hack localization sufficiently; (iii) we present a method to train agents for improved human interaction by using human simulators as a proxy during reinforcement learning (RL); and finally (iv) we develop a method to improve model text generation, and hence agent communication, by RL with rubrics aligned with human experts. Together, our training and evaluation recipes provide a path toward more capable and aligned (co-)research agents.

papers.title_en: Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems
papers.authors: Xu Huang, Jiawei Feng, Jiancan Wu
papers.evidence: LLM改写训练配方实现推荐系统递归自我改进
papers.tldr: 推荐系统需按数据集反复调训练配方，LLM智能体可改写配方实现递归自我改进，但现有方法每轮只提一个改动并完整重训，排名反馈滞后且重训前信号不可靠。RecRSI先从当前模型诊断生成多样候选改动，再让每个候选短试训，用留出探测用户上的完整排名NDCG@10评分，择优完整重训。在两种序列推荐器和三个数据集、相同完整重训次数下，RecRSI全面优于现有自进化智能体，并在两个Amazon数据集首轮达到对手五轮未及的排名质量。
papers.abstract_en: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.

papers.title_en: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
papers.authors: Yikun Zhang, Xiwei Cheng, Mingze Yuan, Yu Zhang, Brian Shim, Aarti Krishnan, Daniel Rosen, Kunyang Sun, Yingze Wang, Zhenfeng Deng, Botao Yu, Bingxu Liu, David Liu, Tianyu Liu, Yuanqi Du, Nir Hacohen, James J. Collins, Wengong Jin
papers.evidence: 递归自我改进智能体优化工作流与搜索策略
papers.tldr: 分子发现需在庞大组合空间中平衡多种生物目标，现有AI智能体虽能自动化专家流程，却难以优化工作流并从经验中持续改进。MoLRSI将工作流与模型架构的系统优化、跨任务持久记忆结合，递归提升分子发现搜索策略。在抗生素筛选中实验命中率达15.9%，高于专家流程的8.7%；在肽-MHC结合子设计中获得8个实验验证命中，并优于Claude Science。结果表明经验引导的工作流优化可兼顾竞争性目标并改进后续搜索策略。
papers.abstract_en: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.

papers.title_en: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.authors: Dianxing Shi, Dingjie Fu, Tianyu Lei, Wangjie Qiu
papers.evidence: 按任务自适应选择推理模式与计算投入的自进化训练
papers.tldr: 自进化训练能借可验证反馈提升智能体在难题上的表现，但往往对所有任务统一施加高成本推理。MORE提出两阶段框架：先建立直答、短/长思维链与代码推理的紧凑先验，再用MATE-PPO在自生成可验证任务流上自进化，联合学习推理模式与token开销。在3B至14B的Base与Coder骨干上，编码、数学与通用推理基准均稳定涨点，推理更准且响应更短、耗时更低。
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with markedly shorter response lengths and reduced inference time.

papers.authors: Xingjian Bai, Jia-Hao Liang, Jayden Teoh, Vincent Sitzmann
papers.evidence: 语言模型智能体在训练中重写优化器代码以自动化机器学习工程
papers.tldr: 针对目标设定下优化器配方未调优的问题，提出反应式优化器OPAL，用预训练语言模型代理在单次训练中检查动态并重写可执行优化器代码。代理可按参数组调整更新规则与调度，无需元训练或跨运行记忆。在语言建模和图像生成上，OPAL匹配或优于所选固定配方，并展现学习率调度、优化器结构、数值精度与动量等自适应改动。该工作展示了训练中在线改写优化器代码的可行性与代价。
papers.abstract_en: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.

papers.title_en: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Zhang Zhang, Shengjun Zhang, Simin Huang, Min Chen, Chong Xia, Xin Fei, Yueqi Duan
papers.evidence: 把事后回合反思转化为主动自我探索以改进具身执行框架
papers.tldr: 具身智能体在开放动态物理环境中依赖策略与执行框架，但现有方法多把 rollout 当作事后静态日志，无法自主检验和迭代框架更新。VISTA 将事后反思转为主动自探索：维护 harness 图记录候选框架谱系，从保留版本与环境证据出发自主生成新 rollout、探测失败与恢复行为，并迭代修改和重新评估框架。在 LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 上，VISTA 逐步提升任务成功率，并以更少模拟器 rollout 取得更高成功率，优于静态反思。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.

papers.title_en: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
papers.authors: Jiawei Lu, Chen Zhang, Jinwei Lu, Yuanwei Song, Yuanfeng Song, Raymond Chi-Wing Wong
papers.evidence: 面向智能体的递归自我改进框架
papers.tldr: 开放域对话式图表生成需在异构库中找数据、处理歧义并跟踪多轮意图，但现有智能体框架静态预定义、难以从重复失败中改进。RSIV-Harness固定语言模型权重，用失败轨迹递归修订外围harness，并以四层框架结合锚点与记忆检查筛选修订、必要时回滚最佳版本。在640任务ODAC-Vis基准上，单轮自改进使六项指标全部提升，可执行性+28.02、图表结构+34.01。这表明无需改模型权重，也能把跨任务失败转化为稳定的框架级性能增益。
papers.abstract_en: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis, a benchmark with 640 tasks for Open-Domain, Ambiguous, and Conversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.

papers.title_en: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
papers.authors: Heyang Yu, Haomin Li, Sihang Li, Jixin Yan, Shiyun Peng, Wanqi Zhong, Tianyu Xin, Yuan Yao, Xiaoyu Tian, Yiming Li
papers.evidence: 机器人策略的免训练递归自我改进
papers.tldr: 通用机器人策略与语言模型智能体能力互补，但执行中仍需根据物理交互后果调整决策。RoboDoctor 是免训练框架，将诊断、落地动作与持久经验记录连接起来，并围绕策略—智能体控制分配、干预时机和物理操作修订三个目标递归改进。在 54 个 RoboDojo-Sim 任务条目上，五维平均分 57.10，原生成功率 49.44%。结果表明执行时可借反馈实现策略调整，但跨回合经验贡献仍需控制实验验证。
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.

papers.title_en: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Lirong Che, Yang Chen, Yimeng Su, Daqi Liu, Zhenyu Huang, Jiong Wang, Yuzhe Yang, Xu Cao, Chuang Wang, Jian Su, Xueqian Wang
papers.evidence: 随任务需求扩展能力的自我改进记忆
papers.tldr: 具身智能体可用历史观测回答时空查询，但现有工具常不支持任务所需新操作。ReSight 分离关键帧时空关联与可扩展派生字段，使执行与编码智能体共享可重处理记忆；EDM 从执行和探索记录识别能力缺口，将探索方案转为可复用记忆构建器、查询工具与技能。OC-NaVQA 平均位置误差由 33.10 米降至 24.72 米，FindingDory 高层成功率由 38.3% 升至 63.8%，真实机器人巡逻记忆亦减少在线工具调用。
papers.abstract_en: Robots can use historical observations to answer spatiotemporal queries in familiar environments, but the presence of relevant evidence does not imply that existing tools support the operations a task requires. We introduce ReSight, a task-driven self-improving memory system for embodied agents that expands the capabilities for processing and accessing historical observations as task demands arise. ReSight retains keyframes and their spatiotemporal associations, separating observation evidence from extensible derived fields so that stored observations can be reprocessed for new needs. An execution agent and a coding agent share this memory through different interfaces: the former calls registered tools within a bounded online budget, while the latter uses a programmable workspace and a larger exploration budget to inspect evidence, write programs, and acquire models as needed. To realize capability expansion in ReSight, we develop Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM), which identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers and converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, extending memory representations and access capabilities as needed. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate effective base memory access and capability expansion. With the execution model and online budget held fixed within each benchmark, EDM reduces mean position error on OC-NaVQA from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and improves high-level success on FindingDory from 38.3% to 63.8%. With the tools and skill frozen, success still improves by 28.3 percentage points on FindingDory episodes excluded from exploration and distillation. Experiments on real robot patrol memories further demonstrate reuse of these capabilities for subsequent queries and new memories, with fewer online tool calls on average.

papers.title_en: ReGE: Stronger Agents through Experience Synthesis
papers.authors: Jiarong Liang, Yubo Wang, Zijie Liu, Yuxuan Zhang, Ping Nie, Wenhu Chen
papers.evidence: 智能体通过经验合成在无参数更新下自我提升
papers.tldr: 交互任务中重复尝试会积累事实、操作与失败经验。ReGE 将这些记录转化为新尝试的自包含指导；ReGE-Syn 用单次教练调用联合合成受限执行记录与产物，学生从初始环境状态适配当前观察。四个基准上 GPT 与 Claude 准确率平均提升 9.9 和 8.8 个百分点，并在 BrowseComp-Plus 显著降低指导构建 token，并观察到成功。该框架无需参数更新或更强教师，展示低成本利用自身经验提升智能体任务完成，并可整合并行智能体系统的执行记录。
papers.abstract_en: Repeated attempts at interactive tasks uncover facts, useful operations, and failures that can inform subsequent execution. We introduce ReGE, a framework for turning this recorded experience into guidance for a fresh attempt. Its main implementation, ReGE-Syn, uses a single coach call to jointly synthesize bounded execution records and available artifacts into self-contained guidance, connecting task-specific findings with proposed actions and relevant pitfalls. A student starts from the task's initial environment state and adapts this guidance to current observations. Source generation, synthesis, and student execution use the same base model, without parameter updates or a stronger teacher. Across four benchmarks, ReGE improves accuracy by an average of 9.9 percentage points for GPT and 8.8 percentage points for Claude compared with unguided execution. On matched BrowseComp-Plus subsets, ReGE-Syn reduces guidance-construction tokens by 98.2\% on GPT and 95.5\% on Claude relative to adapted AggAgent, with observed success. Combined construction and execution tokens decrease by 15.7\% and 35.4\%, respectively, counting input plus output and excluding source generation. BrowseComp-Plus ablations further associate access to process information with fewer student steps and show that joint synthesis produces substantially shorter guidance than Direct history or Independent summaries, with observed success. These results demonstrate how agents can use their own recorded experience to improve subsequent task completion, and suggest a low-cost way to consolidate the execution records of parallel agent systems such as agent swarms.

papers.title_en: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
papers.authors: Brian Ko, Han Wang, Hejia Geng, Li Erran Li, Sherry Yang
papers.evidence: 用世界模型预测机器学习实验结果以加速AI研究智能体
papers.tldr: AI研究智能体提出并改进ML程序时，每个候选都需真实训练评估，限制了每步可探索的候选数量。MLE-World基于Qwen3.5-4B微调，仅凭代码与数据描述预测程序终态输出及置信度，从而以一次推理替代一次训练运行。在17个MLE-bench Lite任务上，其预测与真实终态一致率达77.9%，远高于更大提示模型的41.1%；引导的测试时扩展策略最高提升观测平均性能22.1%，且减少真实执行。该工作让智能体以更低成本进行候选比较与探索。
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. We introduce MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B that predicts a program's terminal output (error traces, training logs, and validation scores) from its code and data description without executing it, together with a confidence score estimating the prediction's correctness. Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents. We build five TTS policies, guided by MLE-World, that compare several candidates per step by their predicted outputs: Sequential revision, Best-of-N, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a UCB style rule that also adds an exploration bonus from this confidence score. Since predictions can be wrong, we run a candidate for real only when its confidence score is low. On 17 MLE-bench Lite tasks, MLE-World matches the real terminal output on 77.9% of held out programs, versus 41.1% for much larger prompted models. MLE-World guided TTS achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model, with less real execution. Project webpage: https://mle-world.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
papers.authors: Sichun Luo, Yi Huang, Mukai Li, Haochen Luo, Guanzhi Deng, Haibo Wang, Jian Xu, Zefa Hu, Junlan Feng, Qi Liu
papers.evidence: 智能体脚手架演化中的评估预算分配
papers.tldr: LLM驱动的agent scaffold进化需反复生成与评估候选，但全量评估成本高。论文研究评估预算在搜索引导与最终选择间的分配，发现稀疏反馈足以维持进化，定向评估可改善最终选择。基于共享信息项与统一评分参照，提出结合稀疏搜索反馈和定向最终确认的预算分配框架。四个基准、两个进化框架下多数设置平均性能超过全量评估，且评估单元约减半。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.

papers.title_en: InfraDev: Can Coding Agents Develop AI Infrastructure, and How Can We Tell?
papers.authors: Yangshen Deng, Jiaqi Ruan, Yeqi Huang, Nick Lau, Guangming Sheng, Luo Mai
papers.evidence: 编码智能体自动化AI基础设施工程
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体基准只覆盖单内核或单 GPU 任务，且测试与提示会误判补丁。为此作者构建 InfraDev，从 Megatron-LM、vLLM、verl 的真实 PR 提取 36 个多文件、多 GPU 的基础设施开发任务，并用隐藏探针与接口提示联合评分。六个前沿模型最高仅解决 38.9%，探针否决了 32% 通过官方测试的提交，原始 PR 描述作提示时无一模型成功。该工作揭示了智能体在结构、状态与资源约束上的系统性缺陷，并证明据此提炼的智能体技能可提升 10.5% 解决率。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and must run correctly across many GPUs. To grade such changes, we jointly synthesize hidden probes, which enforce the requirements the original tests leave unchecked, and a prompt that states every interface the probes call without revealing the solution. We also design a shared execution environment that reuses dependencies and artifacts across tasks, cutting storage by 52-57% and build time by 13-14% on Megatron-LM and vLLM. Across six frontier models, the best resolves only 38.9% of the tasks; the probes reject 32% of the submissions that pass every official test, and with the original pull request descriptions as prompts, no model resolves a single task. Failure analysis shows that structural and state errors dominate and that agents' own tests rarely check memory, time, or traffic. Turning these findings into an agent skill raises the resolved rate of a frontier model on the Megatron-LM tasks by 10.5%.

papers.authors: Shufan Shen, Zhongni Hou, Chao Bi, Yufei Zhang, Guojun Yin, Shuhui Wang
papers.evidence: 自教师演化提升模型自蒸馏性能
papers.tldr: OPSD通过特权上下文提示的自教师对齐学生词元分布，以缓解序列级后训练奖励稀疏，但自教学能力有限导致部分样本指导不可靠，训练难以持续增益。为此提出TESD，让自教师生成rollout并依据任务正确性与上下文独立性获取环境反馈，进行教师侧优化，并按指导可靠性自适应降权学生侧样本。多数据集和多模型规模实验显示TESD稳定优于代表性词元级与序列级方法，表明提升OPSD监督质量至关重要。
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.
